key: Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuna, his strength and insight; May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.
s: The last of three verses to Varuna, who propped the heavens, prays for the singer before the hymn turns to the Asvins; Sāyaṇa, on 8.42.3, reads the ship as the sacrifice, the means of crossing the sea of suffering.

evidence.gloss: The ship in the form of the sacrifice, by which we may cross beyond all troubles: may we climb aboard that ship, which carries well across, the sacrifice. Because it is the cause of crossing the ocean of suffering, the sacrifice is here called a ship.
